verdict.rationale: Modal Sandboxes are explicitly designed for programmatic, headless orchestration via SDKs (Python/JS/Go) and CLI, with docs on running commands, scaling to hundreds of thousands of concurrent environments, and API-driven lifecycle management—clearly suited to CI/automation pipelines. Community evidence corroborates this: a developer built self-hosted GitHub Actions runners on Modal Sandboxes for CI use, and another integrated it via gRPC into an agent runtime. Missing for 10: no explicit first-party CI integration guide (e.g., GitHub Actions/GitLab CI templates) or documented CI-specific examples beyond community projects.
